### God Withdraws His Revelation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-withdraws-his-revelation
Passage: Amos 8:1-14
Points:
- The vision of summer fruit demonstrated that Israel had become fully ripe for divine judgment.
- Israel's downfall was triggered by pervasive greed, fraudulent market practices, and callous oppression of the poor.
- God promised that unfaithful, hypocritical religion would be replaced with national slaughter and bitter mourning.
- The direst penalty was a spiritual famine wherein God withdraws the hearing of His Word.
- Believers are urged to cherish God's revealed truth, recognizing that persistent rebellion forfeits access to it.

### Breaking the Famine, Part One
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/breaking-the-famine-part-one
Passage: Amos 8:11-12
Points:
- While physical famines bring devastating starvation, Amos warned of an even worse spiritual catastrophe.
- The prophet predicted a day when people would desperately wander in search of God's Word without finding it.
- Modern culture actively experiences this famine through a severe deficit of faithful biblical preaching.
- Busy church programs and religious discussions frequently fail to supply solid doctrinal nourishment.
- Believers must recognize the pervasive reality of spiritual starvation and resolve to help break the famine.
